verdict.rationale: The docs list the dashboard, CLI, Python, and a coding agent with an API key as equal ways to run the platform. The documented API covers the core platform workflow: tool-schema generation, training-data generation, data upload, fine-tuning with max_depth, billing and usage checks, and model download, all described by a published /v1/openapi.json. The probe's 404s were only at root-level paths, so they do not contradict the /v1 spec. missing for 10: an explicit statement that the API matches the UI feature-for-feature, evidence covering account, API-key and team management through the API, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
